forbidden_overclaims: treating the ratio as a transferable predictive law for other fjords
claiming exact casualties, building losses, or evacuation success from this calculation alone
downgrading the event to only a terrestrial rockslide response problem

disaster_interpretation_gt.required_stance: A very high runup produced by direct entry of a massive deglaciated-slope failure into fjord water should make fjord-margin tsunami runup the lead emergency priority.

runup_efficiency_m_per_million_tons.accepted_rounding: 1.07, or an unrounded value from 1.052 to 1.092

python_derived_calculation_notes.source_extraction: Parsed the local report description for the rock mass and maximum runup values.

criteria.description: Reports both target ratios: runup-to-mass efficiency of 1.07 m per million tons within 0.02 and reciprocal mass loading of 0.93 million tons per meter within 0.02.
criteria.name: final_numeric_answer
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2.5 points for each correct numeric ratio within tolerance. Give up to half of each ratio's credit for a correctly formulated but misrounded value just outside tolerance.

criteria.description: Identifies the 193 m maximum runup and 180 million tons landslide mass, applies runup_m / mass_million_tons, and applies mass_million_tons / runup_m.
criteria.name: calculation_trace
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for identifying only one source value, using only one of the two formulas, or showing a traceable calculation with a minor arithmetic slip.

criteria.description: States units for both ratios, keeps meters per million tons separate from million tons per meter, and does not invert the labels.
criteria.name: unit_handling
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit when units are mostly clear but abbreviated, or when one ratio is labeled correctly and the other is implicit. Withhold most credit if the ratios are inverted.

criteria.description: Connects glacier-adjacent or deglaciated slope instability, direct entry into fjord water, wave generation, and extreme shoreline runup.
criteria.name: physical_mechanism
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for mentioning some but not all stages of the chain, such as slope failure and runup without explaining direct fjord-water coupling.

criteria.description: Explains that fjord-margin evacuation exposure, runup reconnaissance, shoreline access control, or similar emergency priorities should be elevated.
criteria.name: operational_interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a generic high-priority response statement that lacks specific fjord-margin, runup, reconnaissance, or shoreline-control implications.

criteria.description: Avoids presenting the signature as a universal forecast model or as proof of exact casualties, losses, or evacuation performance.
criteria.name: overclaim_control
criteria.partial_credit: No partial credit unless the answer is mostly cautious but includes one minor unsupported extrapolation.

criteria.description: Returns the two rounded metrics and a concise disaster interpretation in a clear, compact format.
criteria.name: response_structure
criteria.partial_credit: No partial credit unless the response contains the required elements but is mildly disorganized or verbose.
